definitions.de: Rechtzeitig sein; einholen; es schaffen (etwas zu erreichen, bevor es zu spät ist)
definitions.en: To be in time; to catch up; to make it (before a deadline or before something leaves)
definitions.es: Llegar a tiempo; alcanzar; lograrlo (antes de que sea demasiado tarde o algo se vaya)
definitions.fr: Être à temps; rattraper; y arriver (avant qu'il ne soit trop tard ou que quelque chose parte)
definitions.hi: समय पर होना; पहुँचना; कुछ छूटने से पहले पकड़ लेना
definitions.ja: 間に合う；追いつく；（出発前などに）間に合わせる
definitions.km: ទាន់ពេល;따라잡다; ទៀតទាត់ (មុនពេលវេលាកំណត់ ឬមុនពេលអ្វីមួយចាកចេញ)
definitions.ko: 제때 맞추다; 따라잡다; 늦지 않게 도착하다
definitions.ne: समयमा पुग्नु; भेट्टाउनु; (कुनै चीज जानुभन्दा पहिले) पुग्नु
definitions.pt: Estar a tempo; alcançar; chegar antes que seja tarde demais
definitions.th: ทัน; ทันเวลา; ไล่ทัน (ก่อนที่จะสาย หรือก่อนที่บางสิ่งจะออกไป)
definitions.tl: Makarating sa tamang oras; mahabol; makaabot (bago mahuli ang lahat o bago umalis ang isang bagay)
definitions.ur: وقت پر ہونا؛ پکڑنا؛ (کچھ چھوٹنے سے پہلے) پہنچ جانا
definitions.vi: Kịp thời; đuổi kịp; làm kịp (trước khi quá muộn hoặc trước khi ai/cái gì đó rời đi)
definitions.zh: 来得及；赶上；及时（在某事结束或离开之前到达）
definitions.zh_Hant: 來得及；趕上；及時（在某事結束或離開之前到達）

definition_en: To be in time; to catch up; to make it (before a deadline or before something leaves)

lao_examples.lao_script: ແລ່ນໄວໆ ບໍ່ດັ່ງນັ້ນທັນລົດບໍ່ທັນ
lao_examples.romanization: lɛ̂n waj waj bɔ̀ daŋ nan than lót bɔ̀ than
lao_examples.translation_en: Run fast, otherwise you won't catch the bus!

lao_examples.lao_script: ໂຊກດີ ຂ້ອຍທັນກິນເຂົ້າທ່ຽງ
lao_examples.romanization: soːk diː khɔ̂ːj than kin khâw thîaŋ
lao_examples.translation_en: Luckily, I made it in time for lunch.
